Goal! Charlotte FC 0, FC Dallas 2. Petar Musa (FC Dallas) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Santiago Moreno with a cross.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Rodolfo Aloko replaces Liel Abada.
Substitution, Charlotte FC. Will Cleary replaces Nathan Byrne.
Goal! Charlotte FC 1, FC Dallas 2. Idan Toklomati (Charlotte FC) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Allan Saint-Maximin.
